index.title: The Studio
index.lead: Four objects designed by the workshop, limited so they print on our machines. Customise the shape, colours and text, check the figures, then order: firm price, free delivery in Switzerland.

adjust.title: Customise
adjust.text: Shape, pattern, up to four colors, your text: the 3D view follows every move.

check.title: Check
check.text: Dimensions, grams, time and printability are really calculated, not guessed.

send.title: Order
send.text: Add it to your cart and pay online: firm price, free delivery in Switzerland.

receive.title: Receive
receive.text: A person reads your text, then the workshop prints your piece and ships it with Swiss Post.

printable.q: Is what I customise really printable?
printable.a: Every object is limited so that it prints on the workshop's machines (250 mm build plate, PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle). A badge says “Printable”, “Check needed” or “Not printable”, with the first issue in plain words and a “Fix it” button when a fix exists.

price.a: The price is firm and delivery is included: it updates live in the Studio and depends on the object, the material, the number of colour changes and the quantity (1 to 20 pieces; the larger the quantity, the lower the price per piece). You pay online exactly the price shown.

text.a: Yes. A person at the workshop reads every text before printing, within 2 working days. We refuse third-party brands, insults and unlawful content: in that case the order is cancelled and you are refunded in full. Your text never appears in the page address or in the links you copy.

colors.a: By changing filament at set heights, with up to four Bambu Lab PLA Matte filaments: this is what the workshop programs in its slicing software. The shade shown is the manufacturer's; it stays approximate on screen, the spool is what counts.

after.a: You receive a confirmation e-mail with your texts. The workshop reads the texts, prints your piece to order (the Studio has no stock) and ships it with Swiss Post; you follow the order in your account or on the tracking page.

custom.title: A file, a precise idea?
custom.text: For a piece that is not in the Studio, send your 3D file or describe your project: personalized quote within 48 hours.

lavaux.lead: Five profiles, five patterns, up to four colors through filament changes. Printed in standard mode, never as a spiral.

cartouche.lead: 85 × 55 mm, the Swiss format. Four layouts, embossed or engraved text, two colors.

montagne.lead: A mountain from 30 to 120 mm: a peak, a massif or a ridge, smooth or terraced, from the plinth to the snow. Your name and its altitude on the front.

borne.lead: A text of 1 to 14 characters, four shapes, a ring if you want to hang it.
